CITY OF LA VERNE
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, April 13, 2022

1.  Chairperson Simison called the regular meeting of the La Verne Planning
  Commission to order at 6:30 p.m.

2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Commissioner Allred led the Pledge of Allegiance.

3.  ROLL CALL: Planning Commissioners present: Thomas Allison, Jeffry
  Allred, Jeremy Conrad, Jason Lorge, and Jason Simison. Advisory
  personnel present: Community Development Director Eric Scherer, City
  Attorney Bob Kress, Principal Planner Candice Bowcock, Assistant
  Planner Parker Stringfellow, and Secretary Natalie Hiatt.

4.  MINUTES

  It was moved by Commissioner Conrad and seconded by Commissioner
  Lorge to approve the minutes of the March 9, 2022 meeting. Motion
  carried by a 5-0 vote.

5.  PUBLIC COMMENT

  None

OTHER MATTERS/INFORMATION

6.  CASE NO. 103-21VAR; VARIANCE FOR SIDE AND REAR SETBACKS
  AT 5075 OLD RANCH ROAD.

  Ms. Bowcock prepared Draft Resolution Number 1285 for the Planning
  Commission’s review and adoption.

  Mr. Scherer stated that the draft has a typo and the words “thereby
  authorizes” will be removed.

  It was moved by Commissioner Allred and seconded by Commissioner
  Allison to adopt Resolution Number 1285. Motion carried by a 5-0 vote.
 Planning Commission Minutes
April 13, 2022
7.  CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROGRAM FOR 2022/2023 & 2023/2024-
  2027/2028

  Ms. Bowcock presented the Capital Improvement Program for the next
  fiscal year (2022/23) and the next five years (2023/24-2027/28).

  The Commissioners were happy to see the noted projects.

  It was moved by Commissioner Allred and seconded by Commissioner
  Conrad to determine that the Capital Improvement Program is consistent
  with the City’s General Plan. Motion carried by a 5-0 vote.

8.  SENATE BILL 9

  Assistant Planner Parker Stringfellow presented an overview of Senate Bill
  9 (SB9).

  Mr. Scherer stated that the presentation was also presented at a City
  Council study session a couple meetings ago.

ADJOURNMENT

  The meeting was adjourned at 7:24 p.m. The next regular meeting of the
  Planning Commission will be held May 11, 2022 at 6:30 p.m. in the
  Council Chambers, 3660 “D” Street, La Verne, CA 91750.

  __________________________________________
  Chairperson, Planning Commission
